articles.summary: The Garden Club opened in Carroll Gardens, Brooklyn, in 2026 after three years of legal battles. Its founders built a dispensary around a fireplace, local collaborations, and a happy staff.
articles.title: The Garden Club Feels More Like a Neighborhood Hangout Than a Dispensary

articles.title: Four Questions Founders Should Ask to Understand How Cannabis Distribution and Payments Work in New York
